items.title: Scott Hamilton interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: Milt didn’t know that, but the story was that when I was 21 or 22 years old I was invited to a jazz festival in the Rocky Mountains

ctx.x: Oh well that’s a good story but I don’t think it was very true. I knew all those guys quite well when I came out on stage. Milt didn’t know that, but the story was that when I was 21 or 22 years old I was invited to a jazz festival in the Rocky Mountains in which I got to play with all my childhood idols. And it’s true, I did. And it was very exciting. But I knew all of them quite well. I’d been in New York for a year by then, and we had all had quite a good time on the airplane on the way over, and they knew my…
So they played it up for you?
